sources.title: Seedling air circulation
sources.text: Reduce fungal losses in young plants by removing stagnant moisture with an oscillating fan and airing propagation trays.

sources.title: Propagation supplies
sources.text: The greenhouse inventory counts plastic propagation trays and records orders for replacement shelving.

sources.title: Office ventilation repairs
sources.text: A ventilation contractor replaced the air filters and circulation fans on the office roof.

sources.title: Drivetrain maintenance
sources.text: To remove abrasive grit from a bicycle chain, brush it with degreaser, rinse and dry it before applying fresh lubricant.

sources.title: Bike washing
sources.text: Rinse mud off the bicycle frame before wiping the handlebars and polishing the fork.

sources.title: Walkway upkeep
sources.text: Remove grit from the concrete entrance with a stiff brush before repainting the markings.

sources.title: Keyboard dialog behavior
sources.text: When a dialog closes, return keyboard focus to the control that opened it so screen-reader users recover their place.

sources.title: Dialog design tokens
sources.text: Dialog typography uses the standard screen font. The title and button contrast follow the design tokens.

sources.title: Freezer readings
sources.text: Record the freezer temperature every morning and alert the lab manager when a sensor drifts out of range.

sources.title: Key cabinet
sources.text: Log who takes an access key from the cabinet and check returned keys at the end of each shift.
